plans.summary: Two threads: the desktop's new views retouched after the user's test, and the lead mode's defects. Long goals and scopes, as a real plan has them.

threads.name: desktop-views2
threads.goal: Retouch the new views after the user's test: MCP servers, Skills and Kits shown over the pane area like Commits and Worktrees, with a sandbox picker at the top left; the explorer redesigned so a person finds a file without thinking (a breadcrumb across the top, Locations as a visible list, the folder's content as a real tree); a branch graph of the unmerged worktrees; the logo centred on the rail's icons in full screen; a Team leads icon that says leader.
threads.scope: desktop/src/feat/files/ (the explorer), feat/worktrees, feat/commits (only what the graph shares), feat/mcp.rs, skills.rs, kits.rs and their screens, desktop/src/shell/rail.rs, the overlay host and the top bar's mark in desktop/src/shell.rs (say which lines), desktop/src/screen.rs and luau.rs (additions: a vector or lane element if needed), desktop/src/icons.rs, desktop/src/client.rs, desktop/src/bin/standin.rs, desktop/screens/, desktop/fixtures/, desktop/scripts/, desktop/docs/

threads.name: lead-robustness
threads.goal: Fix the lead mode defects better-full reported: a plan approved twice starts its threads twice; a thread that ends before its report reaches the lead is lost; the merge note is cut at the first newline. Each fix with a test that fails before it, and nothing changed in how a person approves a plan or a merge.
threads.scope: crates/core/src/plans.rs, crates/daemon/src/threads.rs, crates/daemon/src/http/plans.rs (only the routes the fixes need), docs/threads-and-lead.md, the daemon's tests for plans and threads

plans.justification: The three areas live in different folders, so a branch each merges cleanly.

about: A plan with two threads whose goals and scopes are long (the user's overflow report): the chips wrap, the goals fold, the list scrolls between a fixed header and footer.
